question: Should ClickClack support manual channel ordering as a browser-local personal preference, with newly visible channels appended to the saved order?
rationale: Current main establishes only alphabetical server ordering; code review cannot determine whether the permanent product contract should be browser-local, account-synced, workspace-shared, or remain fixed.

options.title: Accept browser-local ordering
options.body: Merge this PR and explicitly treat manual order as a personal preference limited to the current browser profile.

options.title: Require account-synced ordering
options.body: Pause the PR and design a server-backed per-user ordering contract before exposing persistent reorder controls.

options.title: Retain alphabetical ordering
options.body: Decline the feature and preserve the current deterministic channel presentation.

recommendation.title: Accept browser-local ordering
recommendation.body: Merge this PR and explicitly treat manual order as a personal preference limited to the current browser profile.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current navigation surface and is the strongest available history-backed owner for accepting a new persistent sidebar preference.
